entries.name: Anthony Gould
entries.summary: Gould (concussion) did not practice Wednesday or Thursday.

entries.name: Ben Skowronek
entries.summary: The Steelers have ruled Skowronek (calf) out for Sunday's matchup against the Saints, Mike DeFabo of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Brashard Smith
entries.summary: Smith (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.

entries.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
entries.summary: Robinson (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Case Keenum
entries.summary: Keenum (coach's decision) is inactive but will operate as the Bears' emergency third quarterback for Thursday night's matchup against the Patriots.

entries.name: David Montgomery
entries.summary: Montgomery (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

entries.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
entries.summary: Samuel (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Atlanta, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Emeka Egbuka
entries.summary: Egbuka (concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

entries.name: Jeremiyah Love
entries.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Friday that Love (ankle) won't play Sunday against the Broncos, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Luke Musgrave
entries.summary: Packers head coach Matt Lafleur said Thursday it's "tough to say" whether Musgrave (neck) plays this season, Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans (Achilles) is out for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Rashee Rice
entries.summary: Rice (hamstring/knee) was not present during the portion of Friday's practice open to the media, Pete Sweeney of The Kansas City Star reports.

entries.name: Terry McLaurin
entries.summary: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn announced Monday that McLaurin has been diagnosed with a torn patellar tendon in his left knee following an MRI and will miss the rest of the season.

entries.name: Tyler Badie
entries.summary: Badie (thumb) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.

entries.name: Tyler Warren
entries.summary: Warren (groin) is ruled out for Sunday's game against the Vikings, FOX59's Mike Chappell reports.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Charbonnet (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game versus the Chiefs, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

entries.name: Marcus Mariota
entries.summary: doubtful

entries.name: Theo Johnson
entries.summary: Johnson (neck) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Texans.

entries.name: Baker Mayfield
entries.summary: Head coach Todd Bowles said Friday that Mayfield (right thumb) is ready for Sunday's game at Carolina, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

entries.name: Bo Melton
entries.summary: Melton (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Lions, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: Breece Hall
entries.summary: Hall (quadriceps) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (quadriceps) was active but didn't play any snaps Sunday in the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs.

entries.name: Calvin Ridley
entries.summary: Ridley (hip) will not practice Friday and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Cleveland, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Carson Beck
entries.summary: Beck (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Broncos, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Dallas Goedert
entries.summary: Goedert (knee) was a non-participant at Friday's practice.

entries.name: DeVonta Smith
entries.summary: Smith (hamstring) didn't practice Friday.

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Dontayvion Wicks
entries.summary: Wicks (ankle) didn't take part in Friday's practice.

entries.name: Drew Lock
entries.summary: Lock (elbow) is listed as questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the Chiefs, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

entries.name: KaVontae Turpin
entries.summary: Turpin (ribs) did not participate at practice Thursday, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

entries.name: Kene Nwangwu
entries.summary: Nwangwu (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: McConkey won't return to Sunday's game at Kansas City due to a concussion.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: Jackson (ankle) was a limited participant in Friday's practice and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bengals.

entries.name: Mike Washington Jr.
entries.summary: Washington (foot) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Olamide Zaccheaus
entries.summary: Zaccheaus (shoulder) is questionable for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: Nacua (calf) won't practice Friday and will be listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Las Vegas, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Rico Dowdle
entries.summary: Dowdle (knee) was a limited participant in Friday's practice and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints in Paris, NFL insider Adam Caplan reports.

entries.name: Saquon Barkley
entries.summary: Barkley (hamstring) was a limited practice participant Friday.

entries.name: Tre' Harris
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Tyjae Spears
entries.summary: Spears (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Browns, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce (heel) won't have his 21-day practice window opened in Week 7, Nathan Brown of The Indianapolis Star reports.

entries.name: Beaux Collins
entries.summary: Collins (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Carter Runyon
entries.summary: Runyon (foot) was a full participant in practice Wednesday.

entries.name: Christian Kirk
entries.summary: Kirk (calf) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Cole Kmet
entries.summary: The Bears placed Kmet (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

entries.name: Davante Adams
entries.summary: Adams (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Dillon Gabriel
entries.summary: Gabriel (back) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Titans, Zac Jackson of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
entries.summary: Thornton (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Dylan Sampson
entries.summary: Sampson (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Titans, Scott Petrak of the Elyria Chronicle-Telegram reports.

entries.name: Eli Stowers
entries.summary: Stowers (quadriceps) was a full participant at the Eagles' practice Thursday.

entries.name: Elijah Arroyo
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald told reporters Friday that Arroyo (shoulder) underwent surgery and will likely be out for the rest of the season, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

entries.name: Grant Calcaterra
entries.summary: Calcaterra (back) was a full participant at the Eagles' practice Thursday.

entries.name: Jalen Hurts
entries.summary: Hurts (calf) is expected to be held out of football activities for multiple months and miss the rest of the season after new imaging over the weekend revealed several blood clots in his lungs, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

entries.name: Jaylin Lane
entries.summary: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

entries.name: Jonah Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Arizona.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (core) was seen jogging at practice Thursday, Sheena Quick of Fox Sports Radio 1340 reports.

entries.name: Jordan Mason
entries.summary: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Friday that Mason (thumb) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Colts after practicing fully all week, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jordyn Tyson
entries.summary: Saints general manager Mickey Loomis said Tuesday that Tyson (hamstring) is "getting closer" but won't practice this week, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

entries.name: Josh Oliver
entries.summary: The Vikings placed Oliver (biceps) on injured reserve Tuesday, Craig Peters of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Romeo Doubs
entries.summary: Doubs (shoulder) is hopeful to return after the Patriots' Week 11 bye and isn't expected to face a long-term absence, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Skyy Moore
entries.summary: The Packers placed Moore (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Tank Dell
entries.summary: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Dell (knee) is on track to return from injured reserve to make his season debut in Week 7 versus the Giants, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Tanner Hudson
entries.summary: Hudson (pectoral) was placed on injured reserve by the Bengals on Monday.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson (ankle), who is eligible to come off injured reserve next week, isn't expected to be ready at that time, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Tom Kennedy
entries.summary: The Lions placed Kennedy (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

entries.name: Tyquan Thornton
entries.summary: The Chiefs placed Thornton (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday.
